page_title: AST 3-1 WOL | Aston Villa v Wolves 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+12' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Tim Robinson lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+12' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Ross Barkley (Aston Villa), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+11' 51:49 – the ratio of ball possession.
90+9' The manager makes a subsitution with Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) coming on for Ollie Watkins.
90+9' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+8' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Wolves are going to take it.
90+7' Flag goes up against Mario Lemina (Wolves) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa).

90+4' 3 - 1 Morgan Rogers produces a sweet pass and picks out Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 3:1!
90+3' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
90' We will have 13 min. of added time.

88' 2 - 1 Youri Tielemans sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) latches on to it and finishes with a quick low shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:1.
88' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:10.
83' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Joao Gomes and he is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
83' Yerson Mosquera has picked up an injury and is replaced by Santiago Bueno (Wolves).
81' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
76' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tim Robinson had an easy-decision to make.

73' 1 - 1 Goal! Morgan Rogers manages to prod the ball to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:1.
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde will be replaced by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
71' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
70' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
69' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

69' Aston Villa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Good work from Aston Villa as they win a corner.
65' Unai Emery appears to have said too much and referee Tim Robinson comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
65' Jorgen Strand Larsen goes off the pitch and Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) comes on.
62' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Amadou Onana is replaced by Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jacob Ramsey walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
61' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Mario Lemina (Wolves) for his blatant foul.

58' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
58' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
56' The resulting free kick from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
55' Tim Robinson blows his whistle after Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Wolves are awarded the free kick.
54' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
50' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
47' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Unai Emery gives a chance to Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) and John McGinn is off.
46' The game is over for Lucas Digne. Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Mario Lemina (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45+3' John McGinn (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+1' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes it short.

45' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolves.
41' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
36' Aston Villa quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
34' 0:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolves comes to nothing.
32' A lofted cross from Mario Lemina (Wolves) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Wolves win a corner.
28' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) is booked for saying more than Tim Robinson was willing to tolerate.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Gomes (Wolves) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
25' 0 - 1 Matheus Cunha (Wolves) waited for a rebound on the edge of the box and left the goalkeeper stranded with his beautiful attempt which went into the bottom left corner, glancing off the post.
24' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes.

19' What a great chance for Mario Lemina (Wolves). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
19' The referee signals a corner kick to Wolves.
18' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolves.
16' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
16' Wolves are ruled offside.
14' Tim Robinson blows his whistle after Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to Wolves, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
12' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
7' Today's referee Tim Robinson rightly decides to book Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) for his harsh tackle.
5' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
5' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Tim Robinson.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
